reason: A is marginally better because it links dwell-time-dependent phase selection to species-dependent diffusion and multielement dilution, yielding a clearer mechanistic extension and falsifiable prediction of segregation during prolonged annealing. B more directly restates the cited 5-minute disorder-to-order procedure and adds poorly supported spin–orbit/hybridization claims, although both proposals remain close to prior work and blur the distinction between an ordered intermetallic and the requested solid solution.
